### Highlights | 更新内容

- 鼠标指针移入播放窗口不再必然抢走焦点，鼠标面板新增开关决定（默认开启，与以往所有版本一致）。关闭后窗口继续跟踪指针但等待点击，这正是 issue #21 与 #40 要求的行为。
  A pointer moving into the stream window no longer has to take it. A switch in the mouse panel decides (on by default, the behaviour every earlier build had). Off, the window keeps tracking the pointer and waits for a click -- what issues #21 and #40 asked for.
- 色调映射策略新增「无曝光偏移（No Exposure Shift）」。曝光不再是着色器里的常量：Auto、三种 Preserve 与 Reference 沿用原本就生效的数值（PQ 0.82，其余 1.08），只有新选项把曝光交还给传输函数与元数据。
  Tone mapping gains `No Exposure Shift`. The exposure is no longer a literal in the shader: Auto, the three Preserve policies and Reference keep the numbers they already applied (0.82 for PQ, 1.08 otherwise); only the new entry leaves exposure to the transfer function and the metadata.
- 设置自定义分辨率不再悄悄改动别的开关。过去它会一并改掉「指针进入窗口即激活」，而两者恰好都默认开启，所以没有人看得见。
  Setting a custom resolution no longer silently moves another switch. It used to overwrite the pointer-entry activation as well, invisible because both happened to default to on.
- 系统权限提示终于按你选择的语言显示。本地网络提示此前被写死成中文，英文系统也只能读到中文；而所有提示其实从未被翻译——语言表根本没有进入应用包。
  Permission prompts finally arrive in the language you chose. The local network prompt was hardcoded Chinese, which is what an English system was made to read, and no prompt was translated at all, because the language tables never reached the bundle.
- 键盘页面两处缺失的文案补齐，中文界面不再夹着英文句子。
  The two missing strings on the keyboard page are answered, so a Chinese interface no longer mixes in English sentences.

### Maintenance | 维护更新

- USB 设备重定向的前两层：任何设备默认拒绝，必须由 allow-list 条目换来放行；总线信息如实读取，序列号在读取处即归约为摘要，不落地保存。本版本不开启任何设备、不加载驱动、不新增权限，原因写在 `docs/usb-redirection-design.md`。
  The first two layers of USB device redirection: every device is refused until an allow-list entry earns the yes, and the bus is read honestly, with a serial number reduced to a digest where it is read and never stored. This release opens no device, loads no driver and adds no entitlement; `docs/usb-redirection-design.md` says why.
- 新增门禁：设置页三张 91 行的重建表各自只能携带与自身字段同名的值；本地化审计现在会读「以 Key 结尾的属性」和枚举里的 `displayKey`（被引用键从 384 增至 394），并删掉 7 条描述已不存在设置的残留文案。
  New gates: each of the three 91-row settings rebuild tables may carry only the field its own name asks for, and the localization audit now reads keys out of `*Key` properties and enum `displayKey` bodies (referenced keys went from 384 to 394) while seven sentences describing settings that no longer exist were removed.
- 新增键鼠映射基准文档：与 moonlight-qt、Citrix 逐条核对上游实现，ToDesk 与 UU 远程只按公开宣传记录，Parsec 因公开资料不可得被标为未取证；文档同时写下本报告自己的一处更正——曾经把语言表里的句子当成功能清单。
  A new benchmark document compares our key and mouse mapping against moonlight-qt and Citrix with upstream sources read, records ToDesk and UU Remote as advertised only, marks Parsec not evidenced because no public source was reachable, and keeps its own correction on the record: language-table sentences had been read as a feature list.
- 发布链条上三处“工具说就绪、发布当天才失败”的缺陷已在打标签之前修好：发布准备工具写出的版本标题缺日期（会被仓库自身的形状审计拒绝）；它不检查发布说明文件是否存在（发布作业会因此失败）；它也不检查 `Version.xcconfig` 里的兜底构建号（历史上每个发布标签都会把它改成自身构建号，却没有任何门禁看守）。三处各自带有能失败的自测。
  Three faults in the release chain were fixed before any tag exists: the preparation tool wrote a version heading without the date the repository's own shape audit demands; it never checked for the body file the publish step requires; and it never checked the fallback build number in `Version.xcconfig`, which every release tag here has moved to its own value while no gate watched it. Each of the three has fixtures that can fail.
